investigation_notes.Script Summary: PowerShell enumerates AD domain controller/forest and collects domain password policy and fine-grained password policies, then outputs JSON; no network calls or persistence actions in scriptblock.
investigation_notes.Historical Alert Reference: SOC-2105 (2026-01-10) — identical script on same host was previously investigated and confirmed by the client as a daily automated compliance check (closed as false positive).
investigation_notes.Description: The alert was triggered by a PowerShell execution on DC-EAST-01 under the SYSTEM account that enumerates Active Directory domain and password policy settings and returns them as JSON. The script content is administrative and consistent with a scheduled compliance check; there are no hard-coded external IPs, staging behaviors, or persistence mechanisms observed. A prior identical alert on the same host was investigated and confirmed by the client as an automated, benign task, which further supports non-malicious intent. Based on the execution context, script behavior, and historical confirmation, this alert is assessed as Low Priority.
